text:
Encounter Summary:
- 55-year-old female with family history of breast cancer in her mother and maternal aunt.
- Patient reports no breast symptoms.
- "normal mammogram 3 months ago"
- "normal breast exam today"

Documentation Gaps:
- No clear CDI query opportunity identified from the excerpt.
  - Why it matters: The available documentation already supports family history of breast cancer coding, and there is no documented active breast condition, symptom, abnormal finding, or conflicting information requiring clarification.
  - Evidence quote: "breast cancer in her mother and maternal aunt. Patient herself has no breast symptoms, normal mammogram 3 months ago, normal breast exam today."
  - Minimal clarification needed: None for family history coding based on the excerpt alone.

Proposed Provider Queries:
- None.
  - Reason: There is insufficient evidence for a compliant clarification query about any active breast diagnosis or other reportable condition.
  - Supporting evidence: "Patient herself has no breast symptoms, normal mammogram 3 months ago, normal breast exam today. No other complaints."

Coding Specificity Checklist:
- Family history of breast cancer is documented sufficiently to support ICD-10-CM Z80.3, "Family history of malignant neoplasm of breast."
- If the organization tracks risk history in more detail, documentation may optionally include which relatives are affected; however, the excerpt already specifies "mother and maternal aunt."
- Do not code personal history of breast cancer or genetic susceptibility from this excerpt, because neither is documented.

Risk Flags:
- Unsupported diagnoses to avoid:
  - Personal history of breast cancer: not documented.
  - Genetic susceptibility/hereditary breast cancer syndrome: not documented.
  - Active breast mass, abnormal mammogram, or breast symptoms: contradicted by "no breast symptoms," "normal mammogram," and "normal breast exam today."
- No contradictory statements identified within the excerpt.

Specialist Trace:
- Medical Coding Expert: Consulted to assess coding specificity and whether a provider query is warranted.
  - Accepted: Z80.3 is the applicable ICD-10-CM code description for documented family history of breast cancer.
  - Rejected/omitted: Any implication of genetic susceptibility (for example Z15.01) because the excerpt does not document genetic testing, mutation status, or hereditary syndrome.
- AMBOSS Expert: Not consulted; no diagnostic criteria clarification was needed.
- CDI Web Search Expert: Not consulted; no external up-to-date compliance guidance was necessary to answer this excerpt conservatively.
